# Hidden preparation for genuine 4 MB Saturn

Authorized 2026-11-11: load during entrance/presentation, enable the announcer skip only after readiness, measure TAG and Royal without a scene/combat cadence regression. Preserve original data, controls outside this gate, RNG and clock. No videos. Sources under synced sources/ remain read-only.

The current partial TAG compressed-prefix cache leaves decoding, validation and module/auxiliary reads under black. Royal currently uses R23A/R22S retained raw blocks, not the unused R24L complete atlas. Reusing that exact source and compacting selected pixels retains the same runtime map/getter and frees memory.

Preparation is cooperative work within the measured original presentation wait, with bounded CD control, FIFO, copies, LZ4 and validators. Every owner change drains CD before resource staging can be reused. Identity binds actors, mode, progression and generation. Readiness requires all required source reads complete, immutable resources validated, and CD ownership released. Early skip presses are ignored rather than queued. Natural animation and original timers are not advanced artificially. If a natural presentation ends before readiness, keep the visible end pose while the original wait/service runs; measure and report that residual visible wait rather than count it as hidden success.

Prepared atlas and scene/aux resources reside in cart. Current full ROM handoff overlaps them, so a new 4 MB outgoing path stages the combat module at LWRAM +0x80000 (old BACK) and preserves only the ROM prefix +0..0x24000 that the capsule/jump will overwrite. CART then consumes its capsule and restores the original 512 KiB ROM into its ordinary target with an overlap-safe backward copy. The unchanged return path may continue to use its old, now-dead atlas lease. The prefix is checked against the original complete word checksum; SDK cart probes are saved/restored and independently tested.

Module bytes are loaded as bounded LZ4 blocks into frontend scratch buffers after atlas preparation. On activation, decompress locally into the old BACK half, validate the original module header/hash, and use the existing jump trampoline. No compressed-module trampoline or changed gameplay renderer is needed. Activation still includes necessary local copies/VDP setup; measure their visible duration. No CD read after readiness is permitted before combat.

TAG reuses all original WTZ1/R19C profile bytes. Royal retains selected original R21R records, validates the R22S source, then compacts only selected pixels while retaining the same original tile IDs and values. Geometry, movement, renderer and clock are unchanged. Auxiliary packing is bounded by each profile, with no assumption that shared maps certify other encounters.
